title: Oh-so-savory Japanese vegetables Stir-fry
description: A delicious, shojin-friendly stir-fry dish made with a variety of Japanese vegetables and served in a banana leaf.
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add sliced ginger and sauté for 2 minutes.
Add carrots, bamboo shoots, green beans, mushrooms, and lotus root. Stir-fry for 5 minutes.
Add pickled ginger and stir-fry for an additional 2 minutes.
Season with soy sauce to taste.
Serve hot in a banana leaf.
Enjoy the delicious flavors of this Japanese stir-fry!
Garnish with sesame seeds if desired.
Serve with steamed rice or noodles.
This dish is perfect for a hot summer day.
It's also a great way to use up leftover vegetables.
This recipe serves 4-6 people.
Be sure to adjust the amount of soy sauce to taste.
